dispositions.topic_text: Consumers, mutability, and lifecycle of the M30–M34 provider tables
dispositions.reason: Each of M30-M34 says its rows are not persisted, a constant of the release, changed only with a new release; the readers are named where they read them: State 3's data_provider Knows names each table, and the State 7 notes of check_value_forms, _render_owner_page, _build_mapping, create_project, correct_project, discard_new_store and _run_backup read their rows. data_provider owns no operation that writes them (State 3, 'Must not own').
